# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.12.2

**Every mode open, and Master leaderboards where you expect them.** This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## What's new

- **Every mode is unlocked from the start**, on every profile. No unlocking, no "Game mode unlocked!" on the tiles and no first-time rules screens before a round.
- **Master leaderboards from the Master page.** Opening a leaderboard from the Master page now shows the Master board: its title, your score, the online board, the players around you, and **Watch Replay** on runs that have one. Back on the main menu, leaderboards are the game's own again.

## Fixed

- **"Game mode unlocked!" every time** on Sequence and Master Evolved. The tile showed it whenever the game thought a mode was new, and PC Plus told it the Master modes always were.

Everything from v0.12.1 is still here: online replays of every board's top 50, Watch Replay on the leaderboard screen, and the Master modes.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.12.2-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
